column1: # Award categories build-awards.ps1 collects from Wikidata. Add a line to add a category;
# no code changes are needed, and the app shows whatever categories awards.json lists.
# id <TAB> show id <TAB> category name shown in the app <TAB> Wikidata item <TAB> people?
#   show id   groups categories under one awards show (see the [shows] section below)
#   people    yes = also list the winning people (director, actor...), no = the film is the winner
# Lines are shown in this order within each show.
# Golden Globes are off for now: Wikidata records winners for only about 30 of the ~80
# years, often dated by film year rather than ceremony, so the list would look broken.
# Remove the # from these lines to turn them back on once that data is fuller.
